title: Anomaly Detection Workflows knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Anomaly Detection Workflows”?
options: The method proves that every prediction will be correct on all future datasets.
The method removes the need to inspect data quality or define an evaluation strategy.
The method always performs better than a simple baseline, regardless of the task.

Anomaly Detection Workflows is part of Unsupervised Learning and Anomaly Detection. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions.
questions.answer_key: Anomaly Detection Workflows is part of Unsupervised Learning and Anomaly Detection. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions.
questions.explanation: The lesson frames the topic this way: Anomaly Detection Workflows is part of Unsupervised Learning and Anomaly Detection. Define the task, inspect the inputs, choose a simple reference approach, and test the result on representative examples before drawing conclusions. The other options make unsupported guarantees.

questions.prompt: What is a sound first step when applying “Anomaly Detection Workflows” to a new task?
options: Remove records that produce unexpected outcomes without investigating them.
Assume the default parameters are best for every dataset.
Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Preparing reference data; then test it on representative data.
Tune against the final test set until the preferred metric increases.
questions.answer_key: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Preparing reference data; then test it on representative data.
questions.explanation: Define the input, output, assumptions, and evidence needed. For Preparing reference data, a small representative check is more useful than blind tuning.

questions.prompt: What conclusion is appropriately cautious after trying “Anomaly Detection Workflows”?
options: An internal estimator score replaces domain review and operational monitoring.
A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
A single successful run proves fairness, robustness, and production readiness.
A higher training score alone proves generalization to unseen data.
questions.answer_key: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.explanation: A demonstration only supports conclusions within its scope. Evaluate representative unseen cases and report limitations before production use.
